companyInfo.description: Circle Internet Group Inc is a financial technology firm engaged in digital currencies and public blockchains for payments, commerce, and financial applications. The company is the issuer of USD Coin (USDC).
companyInfo.descriptionZh: Circle Internet Group Inc是一家金融科技公司，专注于数字货币和用于支付、商业及金融应用的公共区块链。该公司是美元硬币（USDC）的发行方。
